notes: Per the description this is the Deadbolt deck built by Jeremy LaMere and posted (v1.0) by Clint 'GameMaster' Hays, reworked by Olivier De Ridder with Reflections II cards; the strategy is largely Clint's text. Credited to De Ridder as the builder of this version.

The post marks no starting cards; the strategy says to start Strike Planning and Squadron Assignments (and Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice against SAC), so no single starting Effect is set. Heading For The Medical Frigate (posted 'Heading To The Medical Frigate') is listed but not named as starting.

Posted 'Luke Skywalker, Jedi Scout' dested Luke Skywalker, Rebel Scout (no 'Jedi Scout' card; the strategy calls him 'jedi scout luke'); 'Artoo In Red 5' Artoo-Detoo In Red 5; 'Leiutenant Blount' Lieutenant Blount; 'Do Or Do Not & wise advise' Do, Or Do Not & Wise Advice; 'what are you trying to push us on' What're You Tryin' To Push On Us?; 'Out Of Commission & tt' Out Of Commission & Transmission Terminated.

Hoth: Echo Docking Bay is posted x 3 (a unique site); kept as posted. The strategy mentions Tala 2 but the list has Tala 1; kept as posted. The author edit at the top ('out cracken in tychu chelcu') is not applied.
